chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-orc-brut.notes: The Orc Brute bust in the unit's dull dark green, with the pot helmet, tusks, brown straps and the plank shield. Both candidates are identical.

chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-orc-warb.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN
chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-orc-warb.notes: The Warboss bust with a moss green face, horned helmet, megaphone and a brown hide cape. Both candidates are identical; the plate hint is the cape, cut at the bottom edge.

chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-rocket-c.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT
chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-rocket-c.notes: A roped bundle of four paper rockets (red, orange, yellow, blue) with stars on their wrappers, sticks and one lit fuse, on a dark brown plank cart; no crew, as before. The rockets are thinner than the unit's and have coloured tips, not cream cones: the weakest portrait. Both candidates are identical.

chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-scrap-bu.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT
chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-scrap-bu.notes: Gunmetal scrap body with rust and two small hazard panels, the driver olive with dark goggles and a brown cap. The rust is a dark red-brown (#762b1d), redder than the unit's, and eight pixels are bright red (#d61816, 0.7%). Both candidates are identical.

chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-troll.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT
chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-troll.notes: The Troll bust: dark green skin, beard and tusks, the club, and the unit's brown hide smock. Both candidates are identical; the plate hint is the shoulders, cut at the bottom edge.

chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-wolf-rid.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER
chibi-direction-portrait-goblin-wolf-rid.notes: Rider in olive with a brown leather cap and strap beside the grey wolf's head. He keeps a short olive tunic where the unit is bare-chested: at 48 px it reads as the same green figure. Both candidates are identical.
